require manual approval for new minor OR major versions of these packages
require manual approval for new major versions of these packages
stop widening peerDep ranges for custom modules
group all redux packages together
group all @react-native-community/cli packages together
group all @react-native-vector-icons/* packages together
group fb55-authored packages (htmlparser2 & co) together so their tightly-coupled releases update in lockstep
group all patch-level updates into a single weekly PR

hold everything Expo pins a version for, and move them as one PR when they do move, so moving toward or away from its recommendation is a decision rather than a Monday patch PR; scripts/validate-expo-versions.mjs is the check that notices either way, and expo/bundledNativeModules.json is the list this mirrors
the Jest preset must match the react-native in the catalog, which the expo sdk group holds back; its own group, so an approved expo sdk pull request never carries a preset ahead of react-native

let expo's own patch releases open a pull request weekly, rather than waiting on the dashboard: the SDK ships around twenty-two of them a cycle, and holding every one is how the app ends up several patches behind. Expect the pull request to be red -- validate-expo-versions names the packages the new SDK moved, and renovate.json's ceilings need regenerating with 'mise run bundle-renovate-expo'. That list is the work order. Renovate cannot do it itself: postUpgradeTasks needs allowedCommands, which the hosted app does not grant. Its own group, so it never waits behind an SDK package the dashboard is holding. The SDK major stays a decision.
hold the radio transcriber's Python below 3.15: ai-edge-litert publishes wheels for cp313 and cp314 only, so uv cannot install it on a newer Python. Lift this once it ships cp315 wheels.
